title: GASP: Efficient Black-Box Generation of Adversarial Suffixes for Jailbreaking LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical generation of adversarial suffixes to bypass LLM safety guardrails (jailbreaking). While it introduces an automated scoring evaluator (GASPEval) that checks for 'harmfulness' and 'dangerous advice,' this is categorized as safety and security testing rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith traditions, or specific moral and ethical reasoning frameworks.
